capability.summary: Parse one phone number and report validity, region, and E.164 form
capability.description: Parses a phone-number string with an optional region defaulting to US, then returns libphonenumber's validity verdict, inferred region code, and E.164 formatting.
capability.problem_space: Normalization and basic validity checking for a single phone-number string using libphonenumber metadata.

constraint.io_signature: Inputs: phone-number string and optional region code defaulting to US; output: JSON with valid boolean, inferred country/region code, and E.164 string.
accepted_inputs: an international phone number including a country calling code
a national-format phone number paired with a libphonenumber region code, or US when omitted
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.phonenumbers_parse", valid as a boolean, country as the inferred region-code string or null, and e164 as the parsed number's E.164-formatted string. A caught number-parse, region, or formatting exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.phonenumbers_parse", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: defaults missing region context to US, which can misinterpret national-format numbers from other regions
reports is_valid_number only and does not expose possible-number status, number type, carrier, timezone, or geocoding
may return an E.164 representation even when valid is false if parsing itself succeeds
does not verify ownership, reachability, or whether a number is currently assigned
unparseable numbers and invalid region inputs use the wrapper's error envelope

output_contract.description: Phone-number validity, inferred region code, and E.164-formatted representation.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: validate and normalize a phone number
format one phone number as E.164
negative_intents: verify that a phone number is active or owned
look up carrier timezone or geographic descriptions
extract every phone number from free-form text
